responsibility: Implements reusable high-level loop-transformation primitives shared by tree-SSA loop passes. It creates and inserts induction variables and their PHIs/increments, rewrites escaping defs into loop-closed SSA, canonicalizes loop IVs around a single counter, supports loop unrolling and transformation helpers, rewrites loop PHIs after structural changes, and provides the core mechanics that header-copying, ivcanon, prefetching, unswitching, and other loop passes use when modifying loop bodies and exits.
same_name_distinction: Provides the implementation of shared loop-transformation machinery such as creating IVs, rewriting into loop-closed SSA, unrolling helpers, and canonicalizing loop IVs. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-loop-manip.h, it contains the transformation code itself rather than the API declarations used by other loop passes.
